about_short_description.short_description: Humi is a payroll, benefits, and insurance platform developing cloud-based software to automate human resources processes.

product.name: Payroll
product.description: A cloud-based payroll system designed for Canadian businesses to automate pay processing, tax remittances, and year-end reporting.

product.name: HR Management
product.description: A cloud-based human resources management system that supports employee lifecycle management from hiring to offboarding.

product.name: Employee Benefits
product.description: A platform for managing employee benefits including insurance plans, health care, dental, and vision coverage.

product.name: Performance Management
product.description: A performance management tool that facilitates employee reviews, goal setting, and feedback collection.

product.name: Time Off Management
product.description: A system to manage employee leave requests, accruals, and approvals with calendar integrations.

product.name: Hiring and Onboarding
product.description: Tools for job postings, applicant tracking, digital document signing, and onboarding task management.
